brief_jobs_parent_ck.name: brief_jobs_parent_ck
brief_jobs_parent_ck.value: ("brief_jobs"."kind" = 'brief_generation' and "brief_jobs"."campaign_id" is not null) or ("brief_jobs"."kind" = 'image_analysis' and "brief_jobs"."media_id" is not null)

brief_jobs_completed_ck.name: brief_jobs_completed_ck
brief_jobs_completed_ck.value: "brief_jobs"."provider_completed_at" is null or "brief_jobs"."provider_task_id" is not null

claim_issues_span_ck.name: claim_issues_span_ck
claim_issues_span_ck.value: ("claim_issues"."span_start" is null and "claim_issues"."span_end" is null) or ("claim_issues"."span_start" >= 0 and "claim_issues"."span_end" is not null and "claim_issues"."span_end" >= "claim_issues"."span_start")

drafts_age_range_ck.name: drafts_age_range_ck
drafts_age_range_ck.value: "drafts"."audience_age_min" is null or "drafts"."audience_age_max" is null or "drafts"."audience_age_max" >= "drafts"."audience_age_min"

video_jobs_completed_ck.name: video_jobs_completed_ck
video_jobs_completed_ck.value: "video_jobs"."provider_completed_at" is null or "video_jobs"."provider_task_id" is not null
